title: LibScript ReactOS Distribution Profile Specification
description: Declarative schema validating custom ReactOS distribution profiles across i686 and x86_64 targets with selectable NT Service Control Manager daemons, Win32 shell themes, filesystems (FAT32, WinBtrfs, NTFS), FreeLoader configuration, and unattended RAPPS/MSI/LibScript package staging.

$schema.description: Relative or canonical URI reference to this JSON Schema document

profile_name.description: Unique profile identifier for the ReactOS distribution

description.description: Human-readable summary of the ReactOS profile intent and target workload

reactos_version.description: Target ReactOS release version or channel identifier (e.g. 0.4.16, nightly)

build_mode.description: Synthesis strategy: repack an official BootCD/LiveCD ISO or compile from source via RosBE

target.description: Processor architecture, channel, and Win32 runtime target configuration

arch.description: Target instruction set architecture (32-bit i686 or 64-bit x86_64)

image_variant.description: Upstream ReactOS ISO media variant used as the synthesis base

libc.description: Win32 C runtime library ABI target

init_system.description: Windows NT Service Control Manager (SCM) and startup service configuration

provider.description: Service supervisor provider (native NT Service Control Manager)

services_enabled.description: List of NT/ReactOS services configured for automatic boot startup

items.description: Service short name registered in HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services

services_disabled.description: List of NT/ReactOS services explicitly disabled at boot

items.description: Service short name disabled in the registry

display.description: Win32 GDI display subsystem, video driver, and screen mode settings

protocol.description: Display subsystem protocol (none for headless serial console or win32-gdi)

resolution.description: Default framebuffer resolution and color depth (e.g. 1024x768x32)

desktop.description: Win32 desktop shell, visual style theme, and session autologin configuration

theme.description: ReactOS msstyles visual theme or classic Win32 appearance

autologin_user.description: Account username configured for automatic Winlogon desktop sign-in

custom_shell_path.description: Executable path inside the guest when shell is set to custom

audio.description: ReactOS kernel audio driver stack configuration

subsystem.description: Audio driver architecture staged for virtual or physical hardware

storage.description: Partition layout, root filesystem, FreeLoader boot mode, and virtual disk sizing

filesystem.description: Primary system volume filesystem (FASTFAT fat32, WinBtrfs btrfs, or ntfs)

disk_size_gib.description: Default synthesized virtual disk size in GiB

serial_debug.description: Enable COM1 115200 8N1 kernel debugger telemetry in freeldr.ini

package_manager.description: ReactOS Applications Manager (RAPPS) and offline cache configuration

offline_prefetch.description: Pre-stage upstream installers and SHA-1/SHA-256 verified archives into iso_root before offline boot

unattend.description: Unattended Stage-1 (unattend.inf) and Stage-2 (GuiRunOnce) setup automation parameters

enabled.description: Generate unattend.inf to bypass interactive setup prompts

computer_name.description: NetBIOS/Win32 computer name assigned during Stage-2 setup

admin_password.description: Initial Administrator account password (empty string for blank password)

locale_id.description: Windows/ReactOS hexadecimal locale identifier (e.g. 00000409 for en-US)

time_zone_index.description: Numeric Windows NT time zone index (e.g. 85 for GMT/UTC)

disable_gecko_inst.description: Suppress the interactive Wine Gecko HTML engine download prompt during Stage-2 setup

gui_run_once.description: Additional batch commands appended to [GuiRunOnce] on first boot

items.description: Command line executed during first Winlogon session

users.description: Local Windows NT/ReactOS user accounts provisioned via net user on first boot

password.description: Initial account password provisioned in firstboot.cmd

groups.description: Local SAM group memberships (e.g. Administrators, Users)

admin.description: Add account to the local Administrators group

network.description: TCP/IP hostname, DHCP, and DNS resolver configuration

dhcp.description: Enable DHCP client configuration on the primary NIC

offline.description: Air-gapped offline installation cache configuration inside the ReactOS guest

enabled.description: Force LIBSCRIPT_OFFLINE=1 inside the synthesized guest environment

cache_dir.description: Guest filesystem path containing pre-hydrated LibScript artifacts

rapps_packages.description: ReactOS Applications Manager (rapps-db) package identifiers prefetched and installed silently

items.description: RAPPS catalog package identifier (e.g. 7zip, sumatrapdf, notepadpp, vlc)

msi_packages.description: Windows Installer (.msi) packages staged for silent msiexec /i /qn installation on first boot

items.description: MSI package filename or artifact path

packages.description: Additional guest package identifiers merged with components during assembly

components.description: Declarative list of T1 LibScript Win32 components staged into the ReactOS image with PE bitness verification

traits.description: Optional cross-cutting operational traits applied to the ReactOS node

output_formats.description: Target media or virtual machine disk image formats synthesized from this ReactOS profile
